title: Beyond the spreadsheet: Introducing Advanced Reporting
summary: Advanced Reporting brings high-performance relational analytics and executive dashboards directly into Trimble Unity Construct. Stop wasting hours exporting data to static spreadsheets or battling slow legacy tools—get real-time, perfectly formatted project insights natively in your workspace.
